Text: Three players wait at the Stammtisch.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Servus, Trainer! Sit down.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Koch! Put that down.

Speaker: Koch
Text: But it is still cold.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Koch! I meant the guide not your beer. Give that to me.

Speaker: Koch
Text: I was already wondering.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Well then, I am going to Beuterdorf, and we need a new trainee.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Those damn mythological creatures won't leave us alone.

Speaker: Koch
Text: Thos-se daaaaaaaaamn- creatures.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Drink up Koch! You are up next.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: This town needs help, Trainer. Those creatures come for our pitch every season, and you have a lot to learn about them.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: But we have our own weapon against these foul attackers. Koch! Our star player. One of the best!

Speaker: Koch
Text: *hic* ...Jawohl.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Look at him. Completely wasted. Well, a star is still a star.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: So I will run you up to speed out on the pitch.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: But first a few more rounds!
Cheering!
After a few more rounds everyone seems to be in an ecstatic mood

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Aight! Trainer! Auf the Field!
The Wirtshaus by the village pitch, the night before the season. A hundred voices, and not one of them saying your name yet.
Someone is already waiting at the bar. Smoke curls off his shoulders where the beer foam lands.

Speaker: Heatwave Brandteufel
Text: So you're the new one. They told me you'd be taller.

Speaker: Heatwave Brandteufel
Text: He looks at your hand a moment too long, then takes it. His grip is warm enough to sting.

Speaker: Heatwave Brandteufel
Text: Nothing? Fine. The pitch does the talking anyway.

Speaker: Heatwave Brandteufel
Text: The Lorelei? River folk. They sing, you drown, they call it a clean tackle. You'd like them.

Speaker: Heatwave Brandteufel
Text: Enough talk. Whose colours are you wearing out there?
Choice 2 Text: Lorelei. I'd rather they drowned for me.

Speaker: Heatwave Brandteufel
Text: Good. Walk out beside me, then. They should see us arrive together.

Speaker: Heatwave Brandteufel
Text: Then go. I'll watch from here and decide what I think of you afterwards.
The pub door swings open onto the floodlights, bright and very loud. You walk out into them.

Speaker: The Brewer
Text: So you found the reed beds. Bring me forty of it and I will show you what a Fire Brew really does.
THE SCENE AFTER THE FIRST MATCH. They poured something on one of their players and it changed what he was. Somebody at the base knows how that is done.

Speaker: The Brewer
Text: Fire Brew. Reed, heat and patience. I can teach you - but you will need players to drink it, ingredients to brew it, and coin for the rest. Go and find all three.
THE SEASON INTRODUCES ITSELF. Named in the Story column of Seasons.csv, played once, the first time you open that competition.

Speaker: The Head Coach
Text: Eleven fixtures, and then us. Write the side at the top of the pyramid into this scene so the last match has a face on it from the first.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Great Game!

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Though it gets better. Koch is talented, but he isn't a star.

Speaker: Koch
Text: Alter! What is up? You don't think I can kick?

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Can you kick while drunk as well as our star players?

Speaker: Koch
Text: Maybe if you believed in me more!

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Then you can test it out later at the trials! But for now!

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Drink another one on me Koch

Speaker: Koch
Text: Jawohl!

Speaker: Koch
Text: Yeah. I am not a star player.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: You will understand. Some players have a high tolerance, and these are stars.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: They get worn out fast, so they need to switch frequently, but their power is undeniable.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Koch! Drink another! Another game!

Speaker: Koch
Text: Jawohl!

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Servus! Hanna!

Speaker: Hanna
Text: Servus! I see the trainee has been doing well so far.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: PLACEHOLDER (round AN, Guide.csv brewery_tour_1): This is the Brewery. Every beer starts in the Steeping Tank.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: PLACEHOLDER: Click the lit-up Steeping Tank and brew your first malt.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: PLACEHOLDER (Guide.csv brewery_tour_2): Malt! But we are short of everything else for a proper beer.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: PLACEHOLDER: Back to the base. We are going on an adventure to find what we need.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: PLACEHOLDER (Guide.csv base_adventure): The Adventure banner is lit up. Take the first team out and bring something home.

Speaker: The Traveling Merchant
Text: PLACEHOLDER (Guide.csv shop_intro): Grüß Gott! Reed, bog iron, whatever you dragged home - I trade it for beer.

Speaker: The Traveling Merchant
Text: PLACEHOLDER: Have a look at my cart. Come back whenever your bag is full.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Whistle! Hold it, Trainer. Before you blink.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Out there the players play on their own. Running, passing, chasing the ball. You do not touch a thing.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Until somebody shouts PLAY MAKER. Then the match stops and it is your turn. Watch.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: PLAY MAKER! Now you choose who plays. Every Play Maker you pick one card in each Tier, out of three.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Look at this one, Tier I, P:0. Zero power, but the best ability of the three.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Every Tier always has the same numbers. Tier I is 0, 1 and 2. The 0 has the best ability and no power. Higher power means a weaker ability, but more power.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Go on. Choose one.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Tier II. See? Now it goes 1, 2, 3 power.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Choose one, and then the next one.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Tier IV. The finisher. Once the Play Maker is done, this is the one who shoots at the goal.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: More power, more chance of a goal. And every duel your side wins on the way adds its power win to the shot.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: And that is Koch, our Star. See the star on his card? A Star has his Tier to himself and is never spent by a Play Maker. He plays every round of his cycle.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: He should have a star ability too... but nothing is happening. We will see about that.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Now they fight it out, one Tier at a time, starting with Tier I. Let me show you a duel.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: First, ABILITY PRIORITY. The LOWER power goes first. The gold ring shows who has it.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: If both numbers are the same, the attacker goes first.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: The gold box is that player's ability. It goes off first, if its condition is met.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Once that is done, the other side's ability goes off. Same gold box.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: POWER CHECK. Both totals are compared, with everything the abilities added.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: If the totals are the same, the defender wins.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: The higher total wins the Tier. That is one duel. Tier II, III and IV go the same way.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: A shot at goal! Stop! Look here.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: This is the shot power: the striker's power, plus every power win his side piled up in the duels before him.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: This is the keeper's stamina, and its bar. The shot power goes up against it.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: The lower his stamina, the higher this %: the chance of a goal.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Tier I again, but only two cards now. Whoever you played last time is spent.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: A card you used cannot play again until the cycle is over, when all three have been used.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: That is where they wait, down there. The EXHAUST ZONE.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Now pick for all four Tiers.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: TIME OUT!

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Trainer, with me to the pub. Something is wrong with Koch.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Look at him. Koch is a star, but his star ability never woke up.

Speaker: Koch
Text: I am fine... I am fiiine.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: His inspiration is too low. Every beer fills a star's inspiration meter, and when it is high enough, his star ability switches on.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Barkeep! Another Maß for Koch!

Speaker: Koch
Text: Jawohl!

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: There it is! Beer Courage: +1 power for every normal player who played before him. Two cycles to use it. Back out there!

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Koch's star ability is on. Look at his card: Beer Courage.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: The more normal players play before him in a round, the harder he hits. Pick him!

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: TIME OUT!

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: One more thing, Trainer. To the pub!

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Not every beer in here is an ordinary beer. These are the cursed brews.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: An elemental brew can change a player for good. But only a star whose inspiration is high enough, and who does not already have too much elemental beer in him.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Koch has both. Koch! An Earth Brew!

Speaker: Koch
Text: Jawohl!

Speaker: Koch
Text: Th-o-se daaaaaaaaaaaaaaaamn

Speaker: Koch
Text: CREATURES!

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Koch! You did it! A Bergmännlein, and a new ability with him. Back to the pitch!

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Bergmännlein Koch! Look at his new ability: Earth Courage. +2 power for every normal player who played before him.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: This is his last cycle. Use him!

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: STAR PLAYER SWITCH!

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: Koch has given everything. A star is worn out after his cycle and swapped out, and once he has been used, he is out for the rest of the match.

Speaker: Head Coach
Text: In a normal match there are three cycles, one star each. Koch got extra cycles today so you could learn. Now pick who comes on.
